fixtures.content: The worktree hooks of D70 (lot 14): every case builds its own scratch repository with mktemp and removes it.

cases.name: D70: the script creates .claude/worktrees/<name> from HEAD on <prefix>/<name> (repo.yaml contrib.branch), links every folder of layout.shared to the main checkout's - an absent one created empty there first -, writes the exclude block so the links stay untracked, prints the path alone on stdout and everything else on stderr (the warm-build line of B8 included), and reuses an existing worktree
cases.cmd:

' > src/a.txt && printf 'blob
' > packages/cache/p.nupkg && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
node_modules/
' > .gitignore && printf 'product: X
layout:
  shared: [packages, node_modules]
contrib:
  branch: "feature|fix|chore/<slug>"
' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; out=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh alpha 2>"$d/err"); rc=$?; wt="$d/main/.claude/worktrees/alpha"; r="rc=$rc"; [ "$out" = "$wt" ] && r="$r path=ok" || r="$r path=[$out]"; r="$r branch=$(git -C "$wt" branch --show-current)"; r="$r base=$([ "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && echo head || echo other)"; r="$r packages=$([ -L "$wt/packages" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$wt/packages")" = "$d/main/packages" ] && echo linked || echo no)"; r="$r node_modules=$([ -d node_modules ] && [ -L "$wt/node_modules" ] && echo created+linked || echo no)"; r="$r exclude=$(grep -c '^/packages$\|^/node_modules$' .git/info/exclude)"; r="$r status=[$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)]"; r="$r stderr=$(grep -c 'worktree-create:' "$d/err")"; out2=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh alpha 2>/dev/null); r="$r reuse=$([ "$out2" = "$wt" ] && echo ok || echo no)"; r="$r worktrees=$(git worktree list | wc -l)"; printf '%s' "$r"

expect.stdout: rc=0 path=ok branch=feature/alpha base=head packages=linked node_modules=created+linked exclude=2 status=[] stderr=4 reuse=ok worktrees=2

cases.name: the space and the background removal (2026-10-14, GAP-43-44): --space prints the free space, the size of a built worktree from repo.yaml layout.worktree_gb (the whole line matched: the size once, never "30 GB (...)30") and each linked worktree merged into HEAD or not (with its count of commits), and exits 3 when less than two built worktrees fit; --remove --background refuses an unmerged worktree at once, and for a merged one returns at once and deletes the worktree and its branch detached, its log ending exit=0; another worktree's branch is kept; a stray option is a usage error
cases.cmd:

m=$(bash "$w" one 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1); u=$(bash "$w" two 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
echo b > "$m/b.txt" && git -C "$m" add b.txt && git -C "$m" commit -qm b && git merge -q --ff-only "$(git -C "$m" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo c > "$u/c.txt" && git -C "$u" add c.txt && git -C "$u" commit -qm c
o=$(bash "$w" --space 2>/dev/null); s=$?
case "$o" in *"merged: $m ("*) a=merged ;; *) a=no-merged ;; esac; case "$o" in *"unmerged: $u ("*"1 commit(s) not in HEAD)"*) b=unmerged ;; *) b=no-unmerged ;; esac; printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -qE '^free: [0-9?]+ GB on .+; a built worktree: 30 GB \(repo\.yaml layout\.worktree_gb\)$' && c=size || c=nosize
printf 'layout:\n  worktree_gb: 999999\n' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml; o2=$(bash "$w" --space 2>/dev/null); s2=$?; case "$o2" in *'low: '*) l=low ;; *) l=notlow ;; esac

e=$(bash "$w" --remove "$m" --background 2>&1); rm_=$?; case "$e" in *'started in the background'*) bg=started ;; *) bg=no ;; esac
i=0; while [ $i -lt 50 ] && ! grep -q '^exit=' ".claude/local/worktrees/one.remove.txt" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; i=$((i+1)); done
x=$(grep '^exit=' .claude/local/worktrees/one.remove.txt); [ -d "$m" ] && gone=kept || gone=gone; git show-ref -q --verify "refs/heads/$(git -C "$u" symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" && kb=kept || kb=lost

res="space=$s/$a/$b/$c low=$s2/$l unmerged-refused=$ru background=$rm_/$bg/$x/$gone other-branch=$kb usage=$us"; cd / && rm -rf "$d"
[ "$res" = 'space=0/merged/unmerged/size low=3/low unmerged-refused=1 background=0/started/exit=0/gone other-branch=kept usage=2' ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-%s' "$res"
